views.text: In July 2024, a guest on Equity Mates said AMD’s MI300 AI chip was one of the fastest chip launches ever, with projected 2024 sales over $4 billion, and noted AMD’s diversified product base with revenue on track for $32 billion by 2025 and operating margins expanding over ten points.

views.text: In September 2026, a guest on Equity Mates contrasted Nvidia’s 75% margins and strong customer preference with AMD’s lower margins, framing the competitive gap when assessing large-cap AI chipmakers.

views.text: In October 2025, a guest on Equity Mates said AMD grew CPU share from 1% pre‑2018 to 24% by focusing on cloud and data centres, and argued the shift from training to inference created an opening where customers wanted variety, modelling only 8% to 10% share to justify the case.
